name: Release 2 — five independent gyms where student athletes train
notes: These came from the portal's own Places discovery run for ethr-lab on 2026-10-28, which returned 127 businesses within the practice's radius. Names and addresses are Google's, not typed from memory.

Chains and franchises were excluded by name, and so were the two park district facilities, which are public bodies rather than privately owned businesses. Private ownership is a judgement from the name and the single location; it has not been checked against a filing.
NOT VERIFIED: whether any of these is open to partnering. Nobody has spoken to them. All five start at 'new', and an unknown is not a partnership.
Patriot 2.0 had only 3 Google reviews at the time of discovery. That is a thin signal — it may be new, or small. Worth a look from the pavement before a long pitch.

No websites: discovery did not return one for these five, so the field is left out rather than guessed. No coordinates either — geocode-release resolves them and refuses any match that disagrees with the street number or the town.
Scripts name equipment and session length only. Nothing claims what cryotherapy, compression or red light does to a body, and nobody is paid per referral.
The offer is ETHR's own wording, unchanged: 'Your first visit for $25: cryotherapy, compression or red light' and 'A free cryotherapy session at ETHR LAB, every month'.

businesses.name: Glass Court Swim & Fitness
businesses.talkingPoint: A swim club — the one place on this list where student athletes come with their parents and train year round.

script.opening: Hi, I'm here on behalf of ETHR LAB, a wellness studio in Oakbrook Terrace. We're introducing ourselves to the independent clubs around here. Is the manager or whoever handles partnerships about?
script.introduction: ETHR LAB is at 1S550 IL-83, Unit A2, in Oakbrook Terrace, about fifteen minutes away. We have a whole-body cryotherapy chamber — a session is about three minutes — a Ballancer Pro compression suit, and red light.
script.value: Your swimmers are in the water most days of the week, and a lot of them are student athletes swimming through a school season. We'd like to offer your members their first visit for $25: cryotherapy, compression or red light. Your coaches and staff get a free cryotherapy session at ETHR LAB every month. We'd point people here too — we don't have a pool, you do.
script.ask: Could I leave brochures where the parents wait, and would the manager be open to a short chat another day?

objections.busy: No problem — I'll leave these at the desk. Is there a quieter hour to catch the manager?
objections.notInterested: Understood, thanks for your time. I'll leave a brochure in case it's useful later.
objections.alreadyPartnered: Good to hear, and we're not asking you to drop anything. It's a $25 first visit for your members and a free monthly session for your staff. I'll leave a brochure.

script.closing: Thanks very much. I'll note that we spoke and we'll check back in a few weeks.
script.followUp: Hi, I came by a few weeks ago for ETHR LAB, the studio on Route 83 in Oakbrook Terrace. Wanted to see whether the brochures were any use to the swim parents.
